newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kolbenschmidt approves merger with Pierburg.
newsitem.headline: Kolbenschmidt approves merger with Pierburg.

text.p: German car components group Kolbenschmidt AG said on Wednesday that its supervisory board had approved the management board's plans for a merger between Rheinmetall Beteiligungs AG and Kolbenschmidt AG.
Rheinmetall Beteiligungs AG holds 100 percent of shares in Pierburg AG, so the merger effectively paves the way for a full merger of Kolbenschmidt with Pierburg.
"The planned merger has the aim of bringing together all activities of Kolbenschmidt AG and Pierburg AG...in a operating group within the Rheinmetall group," a statement said.
The combined group will have sales of 2.5 billion marks and over 10,000 employees.

Kolbenschmidt said the merger would be accomplished by melding Kolbenschmidt into Rheinmetall Beteiligungs AG, adding that the Rheinmetall unit shares would then remain listed, representing the joint company.
Two accountancy groups had been charged with valuing the companies involved.
Kolbenschmidt said it expected a final merger agreement to be drawn up by the end of June. The merger plans would then be presented to its shareholder meeting in late August, it said.
